# Vendored runtime

Unmodified files from the npm package `@huggingface/transformers@3.8.1` (`dist/`):

- `transformers.min.js` — Transformers.js (Apache-2.0, see TRANSFORMERS_LICENSE)
- `ort-wasm-simd-threaded.jsep.mjs` / `.wasm` — ONNX Runtime Web (MIT, Microsoft)

Served from this repo so the model runs with no CDN or network dependency.
